newsitem.title: INDIA: Bus falls into ditch in India, 25 killed - report. [CORRECTED 09:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bus falls into ditch in India, 25 killed - report. [CORRECTED 09:00 GMT]

text.p: At least 25 people were killed in east India on Thursday when an overcrowded bus plunged into a ten-foot (three-metre) deep ditch, the United News of India (UNI) said.
The bus tumbled into the ditch after driving through an area declared off-limits to vehicles because of flooding, the news agency said.
The accident occurred near the town of Biharsharif in the state of Bihar, some 930 km (580 miles) east (corrects direction) of New Delhi.
UNI said some people travelling on the roof of the bus, which was carrying 120 passengers, swam to safety. Four bodies had been recovered so far, it said.
Rural travel is hazardous in India, where people often take dangerous short cuts to save costs.
